description.p: A Python + PySide6 port of the Compositor image editor (Photoshop-style layers, masks, blend modes, layer effects, brush engine, selections, filters, camera raw, and PSD/RAW import).

ul.li: 19 adjustment filters (levels, curves, hue/sat, exposure, B&W, color balance, vignette, bloom, dither, scanlines, tonal contrast, lens correction, remove background, etc.)
5 layer effects (drop shadow, inner/outer glow, color overlay, stroke) — CPU path with GLSL shader source for future GPU port
16 tools (move, brush, marquee, lasso, polygonal lasso, wand, crop, gradient, shape, type, clone, blur, heal, eyedropper, transform)
Content-Aware Fill, Select Subject, Free Distort
Folder masks, transparent checkerboard, pixel grid at high zoom

release.description: First public release of the PySide6 port. Mirrors the Swift app's Photoshop-style workflow; full .comp v11 compatibility; 142 passing unit tests.
